expectedRealization.rationale: The December launch confirms an already-announced market-opening mechanism; any base-horizon company return must be tied to a new incremental ownership/earnings channel rather than pre-existing quality.

changeHypothesis.summary: Shenzhen-Hong Kong Stock Connect moved from an already-known framework into live operation in December. The structural opening is real, but the event is explicitly continuation and does not by itself create new company earnings.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: Cross-border access can persist structurally, but implementation was known before launch and first-day flow does not prove a company-specific earnings reset.
